population: all odd h in [1,2^m), exact m-step endpoints and prefix weights
selection: Top L conjugate pairs by tail multiplier alone within each (k,s); joint-product ranking only as an explicitly labelled diagnostic oracle
normalization: Removed contribution measured against original W; residual / original W_flat, no silent renormalization
arithmetic: Exact integer histograms, exact rational variance and W_flat. FFT ranks/shares are numerical diagnostics checked against exact layer variances.
scope: Finite diagnostic only. No asymptotic growth inference, no sealed execution, no paid model calls.
